vozclara.description: Multilingual AI study tool — paste any public video URL, get a Knowledge Pack (summary, key ideas, glossary, quiz, transcript with timestamps) in ES / PT / DE / EN. Anonymous, free-tier. Tool: vozclara_generate_pack.

vozclara-pro.description: OAuth-protected (PKCE S256, scopes library:read / library:write / profile). Tools: search_my_library, ask_video, export_anki. Requires a paid VozClara account.
